pain: Accepted Activity Events need atomic durable storage, deduplication, integrity verification and Correction replay.
done_when: The SQLite-backed Durable Object stores validated Activity Events atomically with unique Event Keys, append-only enforcement, stable duplicate receipts and conflict refusal.
History exposes entryDigest and comparisonDigest; verification detects altered payloads, links, sequences, comparison digests and truncation against a trusted head.
Corrections require valid targets and Provenance, preserve the original event identity and replay Supersede, Retract and restore in append order.
Concurrent-writer, rollback, restart, uncertain-receipt, tampering and independent canonical-vector tests are present and passing.
Generated Workers validation agrees with Node fixtures, compiled package exports load, and plain local Wrangler smoke runs without runtime code generation.
There is no production deployment, public HTTP endpoint, secret, One Mind content or weakening of existing assertions.
